# GetAudioEffectParam <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetAudioEffectParam:Float32 effect:Int32, param:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | In | Int32 | required | An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect) or [AddChannelEffect](AddChannelEffect). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `param` | In | Int32 | required | A parameter the effect has (`BB_EFFECTPARAM_*` from audio.bb). Any other is a runtime error. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Tells what a parameter of an effect is at right now, also half way through a fade. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
Print GetAudioEffectParam(muffle, BB_EFFECTPARAM_FREQUENCY)
```
@return The value, in the unit of the parameter.
